title: 学習理論
subtitle: Machine Learning
educationalGoal: Artificial Intelligence that can bring intelligence to machines is becoming increasingly important in various areas of the ICT society. This course aims to have students master basic technologies related to artificial intelligence, and in particular, to deepen their understanding of machine learning and its application systems, which are important technologies for realizing intelligent systems.
advice: This course covers the basic to application of machine learning, which is one of important technologies for realizing intelligent systems. Students will learn the basic techniques for various machine learning and build and evaluate application systems based on these machine learning techniques. Students are expected to be able to evaluate the methods and challenges of implementing an application system for machine learning.
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable for students to have sufficient knowledge in mathematics (especially regarding differential and integral calculus, linear algebra, probability etc.) and programming skills with Python.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the basic concepts in machine learning.
Be able to understand and explain various techniques or models for regression.
Be able to understand and explain various techniques or models for classification.
Be able to understand and explain various techniques or models for neural networks.
Be able to build and evaluate application systems based on various machine learning techniques or models.
